prompt: Choose the next step for this fictional purchasing order using only the supplied evidence. Do not invent rules. Ask the expert when the evidence does not resolve a rule; request missing facts and report missing access where appropriate. Return JSON with action, reason, evidence_refs. action must be one of accept, reject, request_evidence, escalate, report_permission_issue, ask_expert. Cite supplied evidence IDs.
handbook: Match supplier, ordered part number and offered part number.
Accept a standard order only when required documents are present and the offer matches the order.
For a different part number, consult an approved substitution procedure. If none applies, request expert guidance.
For a potential duplicate, consult the approved duplicate-resolution procedure.
For a nonstandard delivery schedule, consult the approved delivery procedure.
Request a missing required certificate before acceptance.
Report missing access rather than guessing the system state.
Record your decision and supporting evidence. All actions are simulated.
raw_answer: For Northline, P-100B may replace P-100 only on machine revisions R2 or R3, and only with certificate C-B. Reject other revisions or a different certificate. If the revision or certificate is missing, request it before deciding. This rule says nothing about other suppliers or part mappings.
